lines.say: A bearing on a machining line has fifty-eight hours of life left. Nobody is watching at two in the morning.
lines.caption:
A bearing has 58 hours of life left.
Nobody is watching at 02:00.

lines.say: Industrial four point zero put sensors on the machine. It left a human to read the dashboard, raise a requisition, chase three quotes, and wait for a purchase order number.
lines.caption:
Industrial 4.0 put sensors on the machine.
It left a human to raise a requisition, chase three
quotes, and wait for a PO number.

lines.say: The data was automated. The decision to cash loop was not. And that is the one that costs a shift.
lines.caption:
The data was automated.
The decision-to-cash loop was not.

lines.say: An unplanned stop on that machine costs eight hundred and ninety dollars an hour. The bearing costs one hundred and eighty.
lines.caption:
The stop costs $890/hour.
The bearing costs $180.

lines.say: Foreman closes the loop. It fits the vibration trend log-linearly, and projects the hour the bearing crosses the standard's stop-the-machine threshold.
lines.caption:
Foreman fits the trend log-linearly and projects
the ISO 10816-3 Zone D crossing.

lines.say: If the shelf is empty, and no supplier lead time beats the failure, it buys the part. Payment settles into on-chain escrow, against a spend permission the plant manager signed weeks earlier.
lines.caption:
Empty shelf, no lead time that beats the failure —
it buys, into escrow, under a permission
signed weeks earlier.

lines.say: A one hundred and eighty dollar bearing executes alone.
lines.caption: $180 bearing — executes alone.

lines.say: A four thousand dollar spindle stops, and waits for a person.
lines.caption: $4,000 spindle — stops for a person.

lines.say: That split is enforced by the contract. Not by a policy document nobody opens.
lines.caption:
The split is enforced on chain.
Not in a policy document.

lines.say: This is the control room. Machine health on the severity rail, the projected crossing, and the agent reasoning its way to a decision about money, as it happens.
lines.caption:
The control room: severity rail, projected crossing,
and the agent reasoning, live.

lines.say: The agent cannot invent a payee. It cannot re-buy a part already on its way. It cannot overspend, and it cannot release escrow on a bare click.
lines.caption:
Cannot invent a payee. Cannot re-buy what is coming.
Cannot overspend. Cannot release escrow on a click.

lines.say: Prompt injection, a hallucinated address, a compromised model provider — all of them end at the same place. A revert.
lines.caption:
Prompt injection, a hallucinated address,
a compromised provider — all end at a revert.

lines.say: It is running on Base Sepolia right now, and it is verified. Press run agent, and it spends real testnet money on your behalf — bounded by the same contract a plant would rely on.
lines.caption:
Live on Base Sepolia, verified.
Press Run agent and it spends real testnet money,
bounded by the same contract.

lines.say: Foreman. The machine asks for its own spare part. A human sets the limit, once.
lines.caption:
The machine asks for its own spare part.
A human sets the limit, once.
